response.sql: WITH kept AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points AS pts FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0), per_race AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(pts) AS avg_pts FROM kept WHERE pts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY race_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pts) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.race_name, p.avg_pts, p.avg_pts - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_race p, overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_pts > o.overall_avg;
